summary: Verified new share-into-Coach feature end-to-end. BACKEND: 7/7 pytest cases pass. POST /api/coach/analyze-image — no-token returns 401, free-tier user returns 402 with 'Premium'/'Upgrade' message, premium admin (stocktradesrvl@gmail.com) with a real base64 PNG returns 200 with {reply, suggestions} and the '📷 Shared a screenshot' user message + assistant reply are persisted in chat_messages (confirmed by GET /api/coach/history growing by ≥2 entries and the tail containing 'Shared a screenshot'). REGRESSION backend: GET /api/config, GET /api/dashboard/stats, GET /api/coach/history, POST /api/coach/chat all return 200 with expected shapes. FRONTEND regression after adding ShareIntentProvider + ShareIntentHandler around the whole app: app boots to the LOGIN screen (no crash / no white screen / no page errors), login with the admin creds succeeds, dashboard renders account balance/equity/tabs bar, and all five tabs (Dashboard/Journal/Coach/Strategy/Profile) navigate — clicking each tab updates the URL to /, /journal, /coach, /strategy, /profile. Coach tab renders coach-input, coach-send and coach-mic testIDs (mic still renders), sending a normal text question via /coach/chat returns a real AI reply plus follow-up chips — confirming the existing chat flow is unaffected by the new ShareIntent code path. The native Android share sheet path was intentionally NOT tested (per review request; expo-share-intent is disabled on web via Platform.OS === 'web').
action_items: No fixes required — new endpoint + root-layout wrapping are both regression-clean.
Native share-sheet path (expo-share-intent) still needs a real Android build to verify end-to-end (out of scope for web preview, correctly no-op'd on web via Platform.OS === 'web').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1336-1368 /api/coach/analyze-image correctly gates behind TIER_LEVEL>=2 (premium) and enforce_ai_limit(user); persists the shared-screenshot user message BEFORE the LLM call so the message is saved even if the vision call raises 502 — good defensive ordering.

server.py:1352 the persisted content string is exactly '📷 Shared a screenshot' (+ optional ' — {note}') which matches what the review request wants to detect in coach/history — confirmed by the test assertion on 'Shared a screenshot'.

_layout.tsx wraps <RootNavigator/> and <ShareIntentHandler/> inside <ShareIntentProvider>, but ShareIntentHandler is a sibling of the Stack — it renders null, so no layout regression. Order is correct (Provider outside consumers).

ShareIntentHandler.tsx correctly passes disabled: Platform.OS === 'web' to useShareIntent, so no expo-share-intent native calls are attempted on the web preview — this is why the web bundle still loads cleanly with the new wrapping.

coach.tsx analyzeShared() clears suggestions and posts to /coach/analyze-image; the pending base64 is consumed from ShareIntentContext then clear()'d — no double-fire risk. Locked (non-premium) users get a toast and the pending share is dropped, matching backend gating.
server.py free-tier POST returns 402 with detail 'AI Coach is a Premium feature. Upgrade to unlock.' — matches review spec verbatim.
seed_data_creation: Test registers throwaway TEST_shareintent_<uuid>@example.com free-tier user for the 402 assertion (not cleaned up but harmless). Admin account chat_messages history grows by one shared-screenshot pair per run — expected, matches the persistence contract.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is ship-ready for the JS/server side. If retesting, note: (1) on Expo web preview the tab bar tabs highlight correctly and URLs change on click, but page.evaluate('document.body.innerText') on the Journal/Strategy/Profile tabs sometimes still surfaces the Dashboard header text because these RN screens all pull the same top hero block — use screenshots or specific testIDs (coach-input, coach-send, coach-mic) to verify the correct screen mounted, not body innerText. (2) ModalQueue shows What's-New → Market-Sentiment → Today's-Edge on first login; dismiss them via get_by_text('Got it') and get_by_text('Let's Trade') before doing tab-bar navigation asserts. (3) expo-share-intent's native path is not testable on web (Platform.OS === 'web' short-circuit); it must be smoke-tested on a real device build.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 7 backend tests pass and the frontend regression (login → dashboard → tabs → coach chat) is clean after the ShareIntentProvider/Handler root-layout wrap.
